name: Haishou Shaonü
source:
Kaiju Girls is a Visual Novel full of Monster Girls.The protagonist lost his memory in an accident and became a KaijuTamer, with the Kaiju girls in the Kaiju world full of danger adventure!

In the wonderful and exciting adventure journey in the protagonist will slowly recall his memories.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2203290/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《骇兽少女》是一部充满魔物娘的视觉小说。主角在一次事故中失去了记忆，成为了一名骇兽驯兽师，与骇兽少女们在危机四伏的骇兽世界中展开冒险！

在这段精彩刺激的冒险旅程中，主角也将慢慢找回自己的记忆。

[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2203290/]Steam[/url]]
